request.purpose: Execute approved Multi League domestic cup key normalization without division
statements: UPDATE `GW002_IMC Results` SET competition_key=CONCAT('GW002|',UPPER(TRIM(sm_country)),'|',competition_group,'|',sm_action) WHERE competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND sm_action IN ('leaguecup','leagueshield','charityshield') AND NULLIF(TRIM(sm_country),'') IS NOT NULL AND competition_key<>CONCAT('GW002|',UPPER(TRIM(sm_country)),'|',competition_group,'|',sm_action)
